page_title: AST 2-1 ARS | Aston Villa v Arsenal 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Peter Bankes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' 2 - 1 Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is the lucky recipient of a rebound. He takes advantage of it and powers the ball into the roof of the net, leaving the goalkeeper completely helpless.
90+5' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
90+5' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of David Raya.
90+4' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
90+2' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

90' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Peter Bankes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
87' Substitution. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) in, Matty Cash out.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pau Torres trots off the pitch and is replaced by Victor Lindelof (Aston Villa).
86' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Riccardo Calafiori is replaced by Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal).

86' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
82' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

78' Golden chance! Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
75' Here is a change. Amadou Onana is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from John McGinn as he is replaced by Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa).
74' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
74' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). Peter Bankes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
72' The attendance is 42888.
72' The foul by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Peter Bankes.
71' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
70' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.

70' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
68' Declan Rice (Arsenal) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) will replace Ollie Watkins.
65' A tremendous drive by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but David Raya makes a brilliant save.

61' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
58' John McGinn (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
56' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
50' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Martin Odegaard, but his first-time effort flashes just wide of the right post.
48' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
47' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
46' The game is over for Eberechi Eze. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) comes on for the second half.

45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
44' It's a nice effort by Declan Rice (Arsenal) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Emiliano Martinez. Easy save.
42' Ben White (Arsenal) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Emiliano Martinez makes a great save.
40' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' 1 - 0 Matty Cash (Aston Villa) converts a killer cross with a powerful low shot that goes into the middle of the net.
35' The foul by Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) was seen by Peter Bankes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

29' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
26' The corner kick from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
26' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul during an attacking move.

22' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
19' The total number of attempts is 1:4.
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Emiliano Martinez stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
10' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by David Raya.
9' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
7' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Aston Villa for a penalty. Play continues.
7' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Ben White (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
